notes: Yamamoto-first monitoring pass. ALFIE, BODY&SOUL, Yamamoto schedule aggregators and credible Japanese jazz sources were checked first; no unrecorded Tsuyoshi Yamamoto date was verified in this pass. These three Blue Note Tokyo engagements were then verified as S-priority catch-up discoveries and checked against canonical RADAR before publication.

events.artist: Mike Stern Band featuring Dennis Chambers, Randy Brecker, Leni Stern & Lincoln Goines
events.factual_description: Blue Note Tokyo presents the Mike Stern Band on September 1-4, 2026, with 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM sets each night. The announced quintet brings Stern together with drummer Dennis Chambers, trumpeter Randy Brecker, guitarist/ngoni player Leni Stern and bassist Lincoln Goines.

provenance.note: Dates, set times, full quintet and reservation path were verified against Blue Note Tokyo's exact event page. The listening recommendation is an exact Apple Music album page for Stern's recent studio album.

en.why_it_matters: The draw is the specific band, not Stern's name by itself. Stern's elastic jazz-rock guitar language is paired with the explosive time feel of Dennis Chambers, Randy Brecker's fusion lineage, Lincoln Goines's deep electric-bass vocabulary and Leni Stern's guitar/ngoni colors. In a room this small, that is a concentrated virtuoso encounter rather than a routine legacy booking.
en.trip_verdict: S within Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Protect a set and cross Tokyo for it; the lineup is strong enough to anchor a serious music night, though it does not by itself justify a transpacific trip.

es.why_it_matters: Lo importante es esta banda concreta, no sólo el nombre de Stern. Su lenguaje elástico de guitarra jazz-rock se cruza con el pulso explosivo de Dennis Chambers, el linaje de fusión de Randy Brecker, el vocabulario profundo de bajo eléctrico de Lincoln Goines y los colores de guitarra/ngoni de Leni Stern. En una sala así de pequeña, es un encuentro de virtuosismo concentrado, no una contratación rutinaria de legado.
es.trip_verdict: S dentro de Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Vale proteger un set y cruzar Tokio para verlo; la formación alcanza para anclar una noche musical seria, aunque por sí sola no justifica cruzar el Pacífico.

events.factual_description: Blue Note Tokyo presents Yellowjackets on October 1-3, 2026. October 1-2 have 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM sets; October 3 has 4:30 PM and 7:30 PM sets. The venue frames the engagement as the 45-year band's first Japan visit in seven years and notes that its 2025 album Fasten Up was nominated for the Grammy Award for Best Jazz Instrumental Album.

provenance.note: Dates, varying set times, quartet lineup, seven-year Japan-return context, Fasten Up Grammy-nomination context and reservation path were verified against Blue Note Tokyo's exact event page. The recommended listening link is the exact Apple Music album page.

en.why_it_matters: Yellowjackets are not being graded for longevity alone. Ferrante, Mintzer, Alderson and Kennedy still operate as a working quartet with a recognizable rhythmic and harmonic language, and this Japan return arrives around current material rather than a nostalgia package. Seven years between Japan appearances makes the compact Blue Note Tokyo engagement unusually worth protecting for a fusion listener.
en.trip_verdict: S within Greater Tokyo/Kanto. This is worth crossing the region for and building a Tokyo evening around, especially for a listener who cares about fusion, electric groove and long-developed ensemble identity; it is a strong trip component rather than a standalone transpacific reason.

es.why_it_matters: Yellowjackets no entra por longevidad solamente. Ferrante, Mintzer, Alderson y Kennedy siguen funcionando como un cuarteto vivo, con lenguaje rítmico y armónico reconocible, y este regreso a Japón llega alrededor de material actual, no como paquete de nostalgia. Siete años entre visitas a Japón vuelven especialmente protegible esta residencia compacta en Blue Note Tokyo para quien escucha fusión en serio.
es.trip_verdict: S dentro de Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Vale cruzar la región y construir una noche de Tokio alrededor del show, sobre todo si importan la fusión, el groove eléctrico y la identidad de ensamble desarrollada durante décadas; es un componente fuerte de viaje, no una razón única para cruzar el Pacífico.

events.subtitle: The Myth We Choose
events.category: Contemporary jazz / Piano trio / South African jazz
events.factual_description: Blue Note Tokyo presents Nduduzo Makhathini on October 7-8, 2026, with 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM sets each night. The trio is Makhathini, bassist Dalisu Ndlazi and drummer Lukmil Perez. The venue describes the engagement as Makhathini's return to Japan after his acclaimed first visit the previous year, centered on his 2026 Blue Note album The Myth We Choose.

provenance.note: Dates, set times, live trio, Japan-return context, current-album framing and reservation path were verified against Blue Note Tokyo's exact event page. The recommended listening link is the exact Apple Music page for the 2026 album. Album guests mentioned by the venue are deliberately not represented as live personnel.

en.why_it_matters: Makhathini has a piano language rooted in South African rhythmic, spiritual and ritual traditions without treating them as decoration around mainstream jazz. The reason this date clears S is the combination of a focused trio, a major current Blue Note statement and the intimacy of the room: it is a chance to hear a contemporary voice still defining his vocabulary rather than revisiting a settled legacy.
en.trip_verdict: S within Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Worth crossing Tokyo for and protecting a set if the aim is to hear where contemporary piano-trio language is moving; it strengthens a music-centered Japan trip but is not alone a transpacific trigger.

es.why_it_matters: Makhathini tiene un lenguaje pianístico arraigado en tradiciones rítmicas, espirituales y rituales sudafricanas sin usarlas como adorno alrededor del jazz convencional. Esta fecha cruza a S por la combinación de un trío concentrado, una declaración actual importante para Blue Note y la intimidad de la sala: permite escuchar a una voz contemporánea todavía definiendo su vocabulario, no repasando un legado ya fijado.
es.trip_verdict: S dentro de Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Vale cruzar Tokio y proteger un set si interesa escuchar hacia dónde se mueve el lenguaje contemporáneo del trío de piano; fortalece un viaje musical a Japón, aunque por sí solo no dispara un viaje transpacífico.
